scheme_name: Swasraya Scheme For Parents/Mothers Of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons
other_conditions: Single or unwed mothers, wives abandoned by husbands, legally divorced women, and separated women are eligible
Close female relatives acting as caretakers of severely disabled or mentally challenged patients can also apply
Applicants must have children with 70% or more disability or mental retardation
Beneficiaries of the Aswasakiranam Scheme are also eligible
Mothers of severely disabled or mentally challenged bedridden patients will be given priority
benefits_summary: A one‑time financial assistance of ₹35,000 is provided to eligible women of BPL families to support self‑employment.
